unconfirmedImplementationObservations.evaluatorReproduction: Not reproduced. In the evaluator environment the same visible test, the full visible suite (186/186) and the frozen containment case pass. A reproduction of a likely operator condition was attempted but refused by the evaluator session's permission policy, so it was not run. It is therefore not classified as an implementation failure.
unconfirmedImplementationObservations.analysis: Non-authoritative. D4 permits the Node runtime and provider program to be visible inside containment. When either is installed under the operator home, its parent directories appear there. The visible test's home check would report that as a leak. The operator failure may therefore be a real D4 violation or an over-strict H1 test oracle. Both are H1 artifacts.
